goal: Extend the Vitest suite frozen in 2026-09-09-vitest-unit-tests to cover the documented backlog (src/trafficStore.ts, the 7 modules under src/db/, src/ingest.ts) plus src/weatherClient.ts and the remaining plain-logic files (src/geo.ts, src/backup.ts, src/pdfExport.ts, src/setPassword.ts, src/backfill-durations.ts, src/backfill-icao.ts). Two structural blockers must be resolved before most of this can be implemented: (1) four files — src/backfill-durations.ts, src/backfill-icao.ts, src/setPassword.ts, and src/backup.ts (a fourth the intake's table missed; it also ends in an unconditional `main().catch(...)` at module scope, same as the other three) — run main() unconditionally at import time against the live flights.db, and each needs a require.main === module guard before it is test-importable; (2) src/db/connection.ts hardcodes the live db path with no override seam, and src/backup.ts hardcodes three more (DB_FILE, PLANS_DIR, BACKUP_ROOT) — no test of src/db/*.ts, the two backfill scripts, setPassword.ts, or backup.ts can run against anything but the live database until a seam exists and a real (temp-file) sqlite test harness is built on top of it. Routes, server.ts, index.ts, the inspect-*.ts CLI tools, and types.ts stay out of scope.
frozen_decisions: Chosen scope: "the documented backlog + weatherClient.ts + the remaining plain-logic files" — not routes, not server.ts/index.ts, not the inspect-*.ts CLI tools, not types.ts.

"Importing any of these three files from a test file today would open and write to the user's real flights.db" — the require.main guard is required before any of them can be imported by a test: `if (require.main === module) { main().catch(...); }`. This changes nothing about how `node dist/backfill-icao.js` (etc.) behaves when run directly — require.main === module is true in exactly that case — it only stops the call from firing on import/require.

"No test of any src/db/*.ts module, src/backfill-*.ts script, or src/setPassword.ts can run against anything but the live database until this has a seam." src/backup.ts has the same problem three times over (DB_FILE, PLANS_DIR, BACKUP_ROOT, all process.cwd()-derived module consts).

"The Designer decides and freezes one convention, reused everywhere this applies (do not bespoke it five ways)" for the DB path override and the real (temp-file, not :memory:) per-test database creation/schema/fixture/teardown pattern.

Full-render coverage of src/pdfExport.ts (spinning up headless Chromium) is out of scope — "no network/browser dependency exists anywhere else in this suite and the frozen vitest.config.ts doesn't provision one"; the Designer may still find a hermetically-testable subset or explicitly decide there is none.
"No test run ever opens the live flights.db — every db-touching test runs against a temp-file database the test creates and deletes."

Ship (DevOps) step: "only if the Designer's db-seam decision touches npm test/CI wiring beyond adding test files (e.g. a new env var default needed in vitest.config.ts or tests/setup.ts); otherwise skipped, and that call is made explicit in plan.json rather than assumed."
Non-negotiable (project-wide): never touch the user's running server or live flights.db.
sequencing_rationale: Phase 1 pairs the Design task with the pure-module work that does not depend on its output: src/trafficStore.ts, src/geo.ts, src/weatherClient.ts and the src/ingest.ts extension all reuse conventions already frozen by 2026-09-09-vitest-unit-tests (test-helpers, fake clock, vi.mock shape) and touch no production file, so they can be implemented while Design is in flight rather than waiting behind it.

Phase 2 is the db-harness foundation alone (src/db/connection.ts's env seam plus the new scratch-sqlite test harness) as its own single-task phase with its own reviewer gate, because six Phase-3 tasks are about to build directly on top of it — a wrong harness caught after six parallel Sr tasks have used it is six times the rework of catching it after one.

Phase 3 fans out across the remaining db-dependent surface with disjoint allowed_paths per module/file, sized by actual line count and cross-cutting complexity (src/db/plannedLegs.ts at 669 lines with trip-activation and hand-close invariants gets its own Sr task; the three smaller CRUD modules pair up or stand alone as Jr work; src/backup.ts and the three CLI scripts each get their own Sr task because both require the same contract-adjacent structural edit — a path-override seam and/or a require.main guard — that the Jr/Sr split reserves for Sr).
src/pdfExport.ts is deliberately last and smallest: its scope is entirely dependent on what Design finds hermetically testable, so sizing it before Design would be a guess.

No Ship/DevOps task: the frozen DB_PATH-style seam is read-per-call by production code (the same shape as SIMBRIEF_API_BASE_URL and WEATHER_API_BASE_URL), so tests set/unset the env var per test the same way tests/simbriefClient.test.ts already does — no change to vitest.config.ts, tests/setup.ts, or package.json scripts is expected. If Design's freeze finds otherwise, that edit is folded into T-006 (the harness task) rather than spun out as a separate DevOps task, since it would still be one file (tests/setup.ts or vitest.config.ts) with one owner.
